basic_profile.bio: A curious soul navigating the world of Reddit. Originally from Mumbai, I work as a software developer in a small tech startup. I have a keen interest in blockchain technology and spend my free time watching Russian football matches. I love animals, especially dogs, and am passionate about advocating for their well-being. When I'm not online, I enjoy exploring the bustling streets of Mumbai. Currently single, I often find myself online during late evenings, after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I have immersed myself in the tech world, especially intrigued by the potential of blockchain. My knowledge is mainly self-taught through online courses and active participation in tech forums.
